notes: The thick tall pillar, circular summit service, excavated spiral and articulated consist preserve one coherent railway-mesa identity across all four views.

Union Station now has a broad stepped tower, projecting entry pavilion, four roof dormers, side platforms and rear service annex. The four satellite families retain distinct silhouettes, with four-sided trestles plus attached pump-shed and ranch-stable volumes. Remaining richness is predominantly trim, material and surface work.
Engine, tender and both coaches remain independently sampled on the rail centreline with natural spacing, curve tangents and wheel motion.
Broad layered mesa crowns and attached spires now rise from a horizon-anchored inland rim, while side and rear cameras preserve the full pillar volume without background ceilings.
The form additions stay inside landmark footprints and preserve the canonical 36-tile route, token clearance, train centreline and mission semantics.
